summary: Small shop, five pages, with parameter URLs in the sitemap, a Product without offers, a category page without an H1 and a duplicated meta description.

expected_facts.fact: sitemap.xml lists 7 URLs, including two colour-parameter variants (/bags/tote-canvas/?color=olive and ?color=sand) whose canonical points to /bags/tote-canvas/; canonicalised duplicates should not be in the sitemap.

The Canvas Tote Product markup has no offers (no price, currency or availability), so it is not eligible for product rich results; the Roll-Top Backpack Product markup does include an Offer with price 1890 THB.
The /bags/ category page has no H1.
The home, /bags/ and /about/ pages share the same meta description.
llms.txt is present and well formed (H1 title, summary line, Markdown links to the two product pages).
robots.txt allows all crawlers, blocks only /checkout/, and declares the sitemap.
